caption: The drawing depicts a closed wooden window with two rectangular panels, mounted in a wall. Each panel of the window is vertically oriented and is made up of narrow planks with variations in brown tones, including lighter and darker brown shades. There are three vertical strips on each panel, providing a sense of depth and structure. At the top of the window, there is an irregular, jagged section, suggesting damage or missing plaster, revealing a darker brown texture above the window frame. The wall surrounding the window is a pale beige color with subtle shading, and the window creates a faint shadow below it. There are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Chapel Doors
